# Types that SHIP but cannot be created, and the create-url placeholder
# that stops them. Each of these reads, imports, discovers and deletes;
# only create is refused, and it is refused before any request is sent
# rather than by Google answering a url with an empty segment in it.
# A placeholder here names a value nothing supplies: not an instance
# setting (project, region, zone, location), not a stored create
# binding, and not a settable attribute of the type's own.

nocreate	gcp.appprofile	{+parent}/appProfiles	needs instance
nocreate	gcp.attachment	{+parent}/attachments	needs repository
nocreate	gcp.authorizedview	{+parent}/authorizedViews	needs instance, table
nocreate	gcp.automation	projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/deliveryPipelines/{{delivery_pipeline}}/automations?automationId={{name}}	needs name
nocreate	gcp.bigtableadmin.backup	{+parent}/backups	needs cluster, instance
nocreate	gcp.bigtableadmin.cluster	{+parent}/clusters	needs instance
nocreate	gcp.bigtableadmin.table	{+parent}/tables	needs instance
nocreate	gcp.cloudasset.savedquery	{+parent}/savedQueries	needs parent
nocreate	gcp.cloudresourcemanager.folder.capabilityconfig	{{parent}}/capabilityConfigs?capabilityConfigId={{capability_config_id}}	needs folder
nocreate	gcp.cloudresourcemanager.organization.capabilityconfig	{{parent}}/capabilityConfigs?capabilityConfigId={{capability_config_id}}	needs organization
nocreate	gcp.config	{+parent}/configs	needs api
nocreate	gcp.credential	{+parent}/credentials	needs oauthClient
nocreate	gcp.deploypolicy	projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/deployPolicies?deployPolicyId={{name}}	needs name
nocreate	gcp.feed	{+parent}/feeds	needs parent
nocreate	gcp.file.snapshot	{+parent}/snapshots	needs instance
